faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Guwahati Lab Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Lab Assistant position at IIT Guwahati is 27th August 2026. Ensure all details are submitted accurately before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Lab Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Masters (M.E./M.Tech) in Electronics Engineering/Computer Science and Engineering/IT or equivalent with 60% or a B.E./B.Tech with 3 years of relevant experience. Specific experience in embedded systems, electronics labs, product design, 3D printing, CAD, and laser cutting is preferred.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Lab Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Lab Assistant position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 55,000 per month.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Lab Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Lab Assistant position at IIT Guwahati through this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the IIT Guwahati Lab Assistant recruitment must be submitted through the online mode only.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Lab Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Lab Assistant position at IIT Guwahati will primarily involve an Online Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Lab Assistant position at IIT Guwahati is a contractual job.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Guwahati located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati is located in Guwahati, Assam, with the pincode 781039.

faq.question: Q10. Who can apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates from Assam and other regions who meet the specified educational qualifications and experience criteria can apply for this recruitment.
